notes: Modified cash basis county, governmental funds only. Statement 'Debt Service' 89,089 (p5) split into principal 85,000 and interest 4,089 from the Road Fund schedule (p15), the only fund with debt service. 'Local Fees, Licenses, Commissions, and Miscellaneous' categorized per config/category_decisions.csv. Transfers printed inside the budget schedules' receipt/disbursement totals are other financing lines with printed_in. Special revenue schedule lines with no actual amount (0) are omitted, except none of the omitted lines carry money. Combined statements (pp23-25) duplicate the fund schedules and are not recorded. Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement (totals equal the government-wide statement; Designated Deposits 27,218 are inside Cash and Deposits there). Read pages 1-26 of 26
